name: hooks-worktree
description: Worktree lifecycle hooks: create worktrees outside the repo tree (in /tmp) to prevent nesting, and clean up the worktree directory and branch on removal. Claude-only WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove events; Codex requires explicit worktree wrapper commands because it has no equivalent lifecycle events. Both events route through one script, worktree-hooks.py. Requires python3 on PATH.
